**何のコーパスか**: 切削・びびり・工具摩耗・面粗さ、研削・放電・レーザ、溶接ビード・欠陥、鋳造・鍛造・圧延・押出、射出成形・板金・粉末冶金、付加製造のメルトプール・in-situ 検出、複合材・熱処理・表面処理、はんだ・SMT・AOI、半導体・ウェハ・リソ・CMP、組立・CAPP、SPC・Cpk、デジタルツイン・予知保全。

**Fullseye でなぜ要るか**: 工程ごとの「何を測れば品質が分かるか」。検査ワークフロー層・`spc` 族・3D 計測・`roughness` 族・振動の PoC の当て先。

**来歴**: OpenAlex から取得した論文メタデータ **2,400 本**(2012 年以降、`fetch_openalex_topical.py`)を TF-IDF + k-means で **64 クラスタ**に階層化し(raptor の `corpus2skill`、2026-09-21)、各クラスタの要約を LLM(claude-haiku-4-5)が書いた。ここに載せるのは**その要約と、代表論文の題名・著者・年・DOI だけ**(メタデータは CC0。抄録は出版社の権利なので写さない)。要約は生成時の英語のまま。**正直な限界**: 文献は原理・選定・校正の研究が中心で、型番やデータシートの数値(製品知識)は薄い。

**使い方(op に落とす)**: 各クラスタの「**使う op**」は、知識のテーマ → op の対応表(`tools/gen_literature_notes.py` の `THEME_OPS`、人が書いたもの)で引いた**実在の op**(生成時に出荷ノート 2,660 本の一覧と突き合わせ、無ければ止まる)。op の後ろはなぜ使うかと型。テーマに当たらないクラスタは「op に落ちていない」と書く(Fullseye に無い領域を隠さない)。読む順: 工程・部品の話題 → クラスタ → 使う op → op ノート(型の契約・実行できる例)→ 実装。末尾の「op → クラスタ」で逆に引ける。

## applications / materials / lithography

**488 本**

This cluster covers advanced materials processing and manufacturing techniques centered on lithography, nanofabrication, and materials characterization. It encompasses laser-based micromachining, nanoimprint lithography, two-photon polymerization, and related technologies for creating precise micro- and nanostructures across diverse material platforms.

- **Lithography Techniques**: Nanoimprint lithography (NIL), two-photon polymerization (TPL), and laser-based patterning enable reproducible, high-precision fabrication of nanostructures with arbitrary geometries
- **Materials Processing Scale**: Methods enable transition from laboratory synthesis to large-scale manufacturing while maintaining precision and reproducibility
- **Material Versatility**: Techniques apply across diverse material systems—metals, polymers, ceramics, graphene, nanomaterials—enabling broad applicability
- **Precision and Resolution**: Laser-based and photon-based methods achieve sub-micron feature control, critical for nanodevice fabrication
- **Plasmonic-Photonic Integration**: Patterning techniques enable coupling of optical and plasmonic properties for enhanced photonic and photocatalytic performance

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 半導体工程(ウェハ・薄膜): [`csi_height_map`](../ops/interferometry/surface/csi_height_map.md)(白色干渉の高さ、zscan → depth)、[`csi_envelope`](../ops/interferometry/envelope/csi_envelope.md)(干渉包絡、sweep → signal)、[`chromatic_confocal_height`](../ops/interferometry/chromatic/chromatic_confocal_height.md)(クロマティック共焦点、sweep → measurement)、[`surface_psd`](../ops/roughness/measure/surface_psd.md)(研磨面のスペクトル、depth → pairs)、[`thin_film_reflectance`](../ops/optics/appearance/thin_film_reflectance.md)(薄膜の反射率、signal → signal)、[`dc_rpca_sparse`](../ops/2d/decomposition/dc_rpca_sparse.md)(パターン欠陥、image → image)、[`ncc_locate`](../ops/2d/matching/ncc_locate.md)(ダイの位置、image → match)、[`mtf_diffraction`](../ops/optics/imaging/mtf_diffraction.md)(光学系の解像限界、 → pairs)

## forming / sheet / metal

**245 本**

This cluster covers the scientific and engineering fundamentals of sheet metal forming processes, including deep drawing, bending, forging, and rolling operations. It encompasses material behavior analysis, simulation techniques, and process optimization strategies for transforming flat or bulk metal into shaped components suitable for industrial applications.

- **Deep Drawing Techniques**: Hot and cold deep drawing processes for various materials (magnesium, titanium, steel), including heated hydro-mechanical methods and radial pressurization strategies
- **Springback Behavior**: Elastic recovery during unloading in bending and forming operations, with size effects in micro-scaled processes and compensation strategies for dimensional accuracy
- **Material Flow Stress**: Characterization of flow stress under different deformation conditions, temperatures, and strain rates critical for process design
- **Simulation and Modeling**: Finite element and computational approaches (DEFORM 3D, Eulerian-Lagrangian methods) for predicting deformation, stress distribution, and defect formation
- **Crack and Defect Analysis**: Detection and prevention of forging cracks, fracture modes, and surface defects during hot compression and forming operations

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 板金・成形(曲げ角・ひずみ): [`strain_from_displacement`](../ops/piv/solid/strain_from_displacement.md)(DIC の変位 → ひずみ、image2d × image2d → image2d)、[`piv_deform_pass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_deform_pass.md)(変形を追う相関、image2d × image2d × flow2d → flow2d)、[`correlation_quality`](../ops/piv/solid/correlation_quality.md)(相関の信頼度、image2d × image2d × flow2d → image2d)、[`speckle_quality`](../ops/piv/solid/speckle_quality.md)(スペックルの良さ、image2d → table)、[`angle_between_planes`](../ops/3d/geometry/angle_between_planes.md)(曲げ角、primitive → measurement)、[`ransac_plane`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/ransac_plane.md)(フランジ面、points → primitive)、[`fit_spline_curve`](../ops/3d/curve/fit_spline_curve.md)(曲げ線の当てはめ、points → points)、[`curvature_torsion`](../ops/3d/curve/curvature_torsion.md)(曲線の曲率、points → pairs)
- 鋳造・塑性加工・焼結(内部欠陥の CT): [`filtered_backprojection`](../ops/tomography/reconstruct/filtered_backprojection.md)(CT 再構成、sinogram → image2d)、[`sart_reconstruct`](../ops/tomography/reconstruct/sart_reconstruct.md)(少数投影の再構成、sinogram → image2d)、[`beam_hardening_correct`](../ops/tomography/artifact/beam_hardening_correct.md)(カッピングの補正、sinogram → sinogram)、[`ring_artifact_remove`](../ops/tomography/artifact/ring_artifact_remove.md)(リングアーチファクト、sinogram → sinogram)、[`vol_label`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_label.md)(空隙のラベル、voxel → labels)、[`vol_region_props`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_region_props.md)(空隙の性質、labels → table)、[`filter_by_volume`](../ops/3d/regionprops/filter_by_volume.md)(大きさで選別、voxel → voxel)、[`vol_granulometry`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_granulometry.md)(空隙の大きさ分布、voxel → measurement)

## machining / optimization / surface

**425 本**

This cluster covers advanced manufacturing techniques that optimize machining operations through process control, tool monitoring, and surface quality management. It integrates computational modeling, real-time diagnostics, and machine learning to improve efficiency and part quality across CNC routing, EDM, milling, turning, and grinding processes.

- **Feed rate and tool path optimization** reduce cycle time and material removal costs while maintaining surface finish and structural integrity
- **Tool wear and condition monitoring** using acoustic, vibration, and machine internal data prevents tool breakage and part damage
- **Chatter stability analysis** in milling and robotic machining improves material removal rates and extends tool life
- **Surface quality prediction** models relate cutting parameters (speed, feed, depth) to roughness outcomes and defects like grinding burn
- **Non-contact machining methods** (EDM, laser-assisted cutting) handle difficult-to-machine materials (titanium alloys, hardened surfaces) where conventional techniques fail

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

## injection / molding / warpage

**151 本**

This cluster covers injection molding defect prediction and mitigation, with particular emphasis on warpage and shrinkage as critical quality issues. It addresses computer modeling approaches, process optimization strategies, and compensation techniques used to predict and control dimensional deformations in molded plastic parts across automotive, medical device, and consumer electronics applications.

- **Warpage mechanisms**: Dimensional deformations result from residual stress accumulation, uneven cooling, and material shrinkage during and after the injection molding process
- **Simulation-driven optimization**: Finite element and mold flow analysis enable prediction of part deformation without costly trial-and-error manufacturing trials
- **Multi-objective optimization frameworks**: Bayesian optimization, NSGA-III algorithms, and Taguchi-Gray relational analysis balance competing quality metrics (warpage, shrinkage, clamp force, part weight)
- **Cavity shape compensation**: Adaptive mold cavity design can offset expected deformations to achieve target dimensions
- **Process parameter sensitivity**: Mold temperature, injection pressure, cooling time, gate location, and material composition significantly influence warpage severity

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

## welding / weld / arc

**174 本**

This cluster covers arc welding and related joining processes, encompassing advanced welding techniques, process control, quality assessment, and the physical phenomena governing weld formation. The documents address both traditional arc welding methods (gas metal arc, submerged arc) and hybrid approaches, with emphasis on thermal dynamics, structural integrity, and process optimization across diverse materials and applications.

- **Arc Welding Processes**: Gas metal arc welding (GMAW), submerged arc welding (SAW), laser-arc hybrid welding, and emerging solid-state joining methods (HYB process) each present distinct thermal and mechanical characteristics
- **Thermal Control & Heat Distribution**: Temperature management during welding critically influences material properties, residual stresses, and final weld quality; Goldak thermal models enable predictive analysis
- **Residual Stress & Distortion**: Welding inherently generates residual stresses and geometric distortion; stress engineering and controlled cooling strategies can mitigate these effects
- **Weld Quality Assessment**: Multiple inspection modalities exist (vision, acoustic emission, ultrasonic, eddy current) for in-process and post-process quality verification
- **Material Compatibility**: Different base metals (Al, Fe, Ti, Cu, duplex stainless) and alloy systems require process-specific parameter optimization

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 溶接(ビード形状・溶け込み): [`decode_fringe`](../ops/3d/structured_light/decode_fringe.md)(構造化光の縞を復号、images → depth)、[`unwrap_phase_2d`](../ops/3d/structured_light/unwrap_phase_2d.md)(位相のアンラップ、image2d → image2d)、[`triangulate_column`](../ops/3d/structured_light/triangulate_column.md)(三角測量 → ビードの高さ、image2d → depth)、[`fit_poly_surface`](../ops/3d/surface_fit/fit_poly_surface.md)(母材面、image2d × image2d × image2d → poly_surface)、[`surface_form_error`](../ops/3d/surface_fit/surface_form_error.md)(ビードの形状誤差、image2d → measurement)、[`specular_free_transform`](../ops/specular/dichromatic/specular_free_transform.md)(アークの映り込みを除く、rgbimage → rgbimage)、[`vol_wall_thickness`](../ops/3d/probe/vol_wall_thickness.md)(CT の溶け込み深さ、voxel → signal)、[`beam_hardening_correct`](../ops/tomography/artifact/beam_hardening_correct.md)(金属 CT のアーチファクト、sinogram → sinogram)
- 板金・成形(曲げ角・ひずみ): [`strain_from_displacement`](../ops/piv/solid/strain_from_displacement.md)(DIC の変位 → ひずみ、image2d × image2d → image2d)、[`piv_deform_pass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_deform_pass.md)(変形を追う相関、image2d × image2d × flow2d → flow2d)、[`correlation_quality`](../ops/piv/solid/correlation_quality.md)(相関の信頼度、image2d × image2d × flow2d → image2d)、[`speckle_quality`](../ops/piv/solid/speckle_quality.md)(スペックルの良さ、image2d → table)、[`angle_between_planes`](../ops/3d/geometry/angle_between_planes.md)(曲げ角、primitive → measurement)、[`ransac_plane`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/ransac_plane.md)(フランジ面、points → primitive)、[`fit_spline_curve`](../ops/3d/curve/fit_spline_curve.md)(曲げ線の当てはめ、points → points)、[`curvature_torsion`](../ops/3d/curve/curvature_torsion.md)(曲線の曲率、points → pairs)
- き裂・ひずみ・損傷の画像計測: [`piv_multipass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_multipass.md)(多段の変位推定、image2d × image2d → flow2d)、[`motion_magnify`](../ops/motionmag/magnify/motion_magnify.md)(微小変形の拡大、video → table)、[`displacement_series`](../ops/motionmag/measure/displacement_series.md)(変位の時系列、video → pairs)、[`vol_frangi`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_frangi.md)(CT 中の管状き裂の強調、voxel → voxel)、[`canny`](../ops/2d/segmentation/canny.md)(き裂のエッジ、image → region)、[`hessian3d`](../ops/3d/feature/hessian3d.md)(3D の線状構造、voxel → hessian)、[`distance_ridge`](../ops/3d/medial/distance_ridge.md)(き裂の中心線、voxel → voxel)

## defect / detection / inspection

**255 本**

This cluster covers automated defect detection and inspection methodologies across manufacturing domains, with emphasis on visual inspection, image segmentation, and deep learning-based classification techniques. It addresses both in-situ real-time monitoring during production and post-process quality assurance for electronics, composites, additive manufacturing, and precision machining.

- **Visual inspection automation**: Deep learning object detection networks (YOLO, Faster R-CNN, etc.) enable automated surface defect classification without human intervention
- **Image segmentation for defect localization**: Convolutional approaches and semantic segmentation extract meaningful feature representations from manufacturing process imagery
- **Time-series and multi-modal monitoring**: Combining imaging data with process parameters (temperature, laser power, tool wear signatures) improves defect prediction accuracy
- **Synthetic data augmentation**: Generated training datasets address data scarcity in specialized manufacturing contexts (fiber layup, additive manufacturing)
- **Real-time in-situ detection**: Fast video analysis pipelines enable closed-loop process control during laser-based, powder bed fusion, and welding operations

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 寸法・幾何公差の計測 —— 入口: 検査ワークフロー層(計測 → 仕様 → 根拠つき Verdict)
- 寸法・幾何公差の計測: [`m1_measure_pos`](../ops/2d/measure1d/m1_measure_pos.md)(エッジ位置(1-D 計測)、image → contour)、[`m1_measure_pairs`](../ops/2d/measure1d/m1_measure_pairs.md)(対のエッジ = 幅、image → feature)、[`edges_sub_pix`](../ops/2d/contour/edges_sub_pix.md)(サブピクセル輪郭、image → contour)、[`fit_poly_surface`](../ops/3d/surface_fit/fit_poly_surface.md)(面の当てはめ、image2d × image2d × image2d → poly_surface)、[`surface_form_error`](../ops/3d/surface_fit/surface_form_error.md)(平面度・形状誤差、image2d → measurement)、[`ransac_plane`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/ransac_plane.md)(基準面、points → primitive)、[`distance_point_plane`](../ops/3d/geometry/distance_point_plane.md)(点と面の距離(高さ)、points × primitive → measurement)、[`angle_between_planes`](../ops/3d/geometry/angle_between_planes.md)(面の角度、primitive → measurement)

## microstructure / properties / solder

**323 本**

This cluster covers the relationship between microstructure development and final material properties in solder joints and related metallurgical systems. It integrates knowledge of solidification behavior, phase formation, defect mechanisms, and mechanical performance across soldering processes, casting operations, and powder metallurgy approaches.

- **Solder joint microstructure** — Intermetallic compound (IMC) formation, grain size distribution, and phase morphology directly determine joint reliability and mechanical performance
- **Solidification mechanisms** — Cooling rate, thermal gradients, and nucleation conditions control final microstructure and defect formation in solder and cast materials
- **Process-property relationships** — Soldering parameters (temperature, dwell time, cooling profile) and surface finishes influence interfacial reactions and microstructural evolution
- **Defect formation and propagation** — Voids, cracks, segregation, and porosity arise from solidification dynamics and thermal stress; their morphology and location predict failure modes
- **Heat treatment effects** — Post-processing thermal cycles modify grain structure, carbide distribution, and residual stress to improve or degrade mechanical properties

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- PCB / SMT の検査: [`ncc_locate`](../ops/2d/matching/ncc_locate.md)(部品の位置決め、image → match)、[`shape_locate`](../ops/2d/matching/shape_locate.md)(形状マッチング、image → match)、[`edges_sub_pix`](../ops/2d/contour/edges_sub_pix.md)(はんだフィレットの輪郭、image → contour)、[`illumination_design`](../ops/optics/illumination/illumination_design.md)(多方向照明の設計、 → table)、[`defect_contrast`](../ops/optics/illumination/defect_contrast.md)(欠陥コントラスト、table → table)、[`dc_rpca_sparse`](../ops/2d/decomposition/dc_rpca_sparse.md)(異物・欠け、image → image)、[`fbp_volume`](../ops/tomography/volume/fbp_volume.md)(X 線 CT(BGA のボイド)、sinostack → voxel)、[`vol_granulometry`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_granulometry.md)(ボイドの大きさ分布、voxel → measurement)
- 材料(見え方・組織・表面): [`spectrum_to_srgb`](../ops/optics/appearance/spectrum_to_srgb.md)(分光 → 色、signal → vector)、[`thin_film_reflectance`](../ops/optics/appearance/thin_film_reflectance.md)(薄膜の干渉色、signal → signal)、[`material_catalog`](../ops/optics/material/material_catalog.md)(材質の外観表、 → table)、[`oren_nayar`](../ops/optics/material/oren_nayar.md)(粗い面の反射、normalmap → image2d)、[`brdf_microfacet`](../ops/specular/reflectance/brdf_microfacet.md)(微小面の反射、normalmap → image2d)、[`metallic_flake_normals`](../ops/optics/surface/metallic_flake_normals.md)(メタリック塗装、 → normalmap)、[`corrosion_mask`](../ops/optics/surface/corrosion_mask.md)(腐食域、 → image2d)、[`cooc_feature_matrix`](../ops/2d/texture/cooc_feature_matrix.md)(組織のテクスチャ、image → feature)
- in-situ 監視(メルトプール・高速動画): [`temporal_bandpass`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_bandpass.md)(動画の時間帯域(揺らぎ)、video → video)、[`motion_magnify`](../ops/motionmag/magnify/motion_magnify.md)(微小な動きの拡大、video → table)、[`video_spacetime_cube`](../ops/videocube/cube/video_spacetime_cube.md)(時空間の立方体、video → voxel)、[`video_summary_keyframes`](../ops/videocube/summary/video_summary_keyframes.md)(要約コマ、video → indices)、[`blob_count`](../ops/2d/features/blob_count.md)(スパッタ・粒の数、region → feature)、[`area_center`](../ops/2d/features/area_center.md)(溶融池の面積と重心、region → match)、[`volseq_magnify_motion`](../ops/live4d/time/volseq_magnify_motion.md)(3D+t の拍動の拡大、volseq → volseq)、[`focus_sweep_height_video`](../ops/live4d/render/focus_sweep_height_video.md)(焦点掃引 → 高さの時系列、volseq → video)
- 外観欠陥の検出(成形・表面): [`dc_local_contrast_norm`](../ops/2d/decomposition/dc_local_contrast_norm.md)(照明むらを除いた局所コントラスト、image → image)、[`lighting_sweep`](../ops/optics/illumination/lighting_sweep.md)(照明を振って最良を探す、 → pairs)、[`auto_threshold`](../ops/2d/segmentation/auto_threshold.md)(二値化、image → region)、[`circularity`](../ops/2d/features/circularity.md)(形の記述、region → feature)
- き裂・ひずみ・損傷の画像計測: [`strain_from_displacement`](../ops/piv/solid/strain_from_displacement.md)(全視野ひずみ、image2d × image2d → image2d)、[`piv_multipass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_multipass.md)(多段の変位推定、image2d × image2d → flow2d)、[`displacement_series`](../ops/motionmag/measure/displacement_series.md)(変位の時系列、video → pairs)、[`vol_frangi`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_frangi.md)(CT 中の管状き裂の強調、voxel → voxel)、[`canny`](../ops/2d/segmentation/canny.md)(き裂のエッジ、image → region)、[`hessian3d`](../ops/3d/feature/hessian3d.md)(3D の線状構造、voxel → hessian)、[`distance_ridge`](../ops/3d/medial/distance_ridge.md)(き裂の中心線、voxel → voxel)
- 鋳造・塑性加工・焼結(内部欠陥の CT): [`filtered_backprojection`](../ops/tomography/reconstruct/filtered_backprojection.md)(CT 再構成、sinogram → image2d)、[`sart_reconstruct`](../ops/tomography/reconstruct/sart_reconstruct.md)(少数投影の再構成、sinogram → image2d)、[`beam_hardening_correct`](../ops/tomography/artifact/beam_hardening_correct.md)(カッピングの補正、sinogram → sinogram)、[`ring_artifact_remove`](../ops/tomography/artifact/ring_artifact_remove.md)(リングアーチファクト、sinogram → sinogram)、[`vol_label`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_label.md)(空隙のラベル、voxel → labels)、[`vol_region_props`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_region_props.md)(空隙の性質、labels → table)、[`filter_by_volume`](../ops/3d/regionprops/filter_by_volume.md)(大きさで選別、voxel → voxel)

### casting / hot / tearing

This cluster covers hot tearing and cracking defects in metal casting processes, particularly in magnesium alloys and continuous steel casting.

## additive / manufacturing / printing

**339 本**

This cluster covers the foundations and broad landscape of additive manufacturing (AM) and 3D printing technologies, encompassing material systems, processing techniques, and applications across metal fusion, polymer extrusion, and biomedical domains. It addresses how layer-by-layer fabrication methods enable complex geometries, functional gradient structures, and novel materials—while introducing thermal, mechanical, and quality challenges inherent to rapid solidification and non-equilibrium processing.

- **Material behavior under AM conditions:** Rapid cooling rates, complex thermal cycles, and solidification dynamics produce microstructures and properties that differ significantly from conventional manufacturing; alloy selection and composition must account for these non-equilibrium effects.
- **Process monitoring and control:** In situ optical, thermal, and melt-pool monitoring enables detection of defects, porosity, and track quality; machine learning approaches can automate defect classification from video and sensor data.
- **Energy coupling physics:** Laser-material interactions, absorptivity, and energy transfer mechanisms determine melt-pool dynamics, penetration depth, and process stability across powder-bed and extrusion platforms.
- **Dimensional accuracy and material properties:** Warpage, shrinkage, and dimensional inaccuracy are persistent challenges in polymer extrusion (FDM); metal AM introduces residual stress and microstructural heterogeneity.
- **Functionally graded and composite structures:** AM enables multi-scale design and spatial composition variation to achieve tailored functional properties—mechanical, thermal, electrical—not feasible with conventional subtractive methods.

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 付加製造(スライス・G-code・層検査): [`mesh_slice_contours`](../ops/printpath/slice/mesh_slice_contours.md)(メッシュを層の輪郭に、mesh → table)、[`mesh_slice_stack`](../ops/printpath/slice/mesh_slice_stack.md)(層マスクの積み、mesh → voxel)、[`contours_to_gcode`](../ops/printpath/slice/contours_to_gcode.md)(輪郭 → G-code、table → table)、[`gcode_read`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_read.md)(G-code を線分の表に、text → table)、[`gcode_write`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_write.md)(表 → G-code、table × text → text)、[`gcode_layer_image`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_layer_image.md)(層の期待画像、table → image2d)、[`gcode_extrusion_volume`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_extrusion_volume.md)(押し出し量、table → measurement)、[`gcode_time_estimate`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_time_estimate.md)(所要時間、table → measurement)
- in-situ 監視(メルトプール・高速動画): [`temporal_bandpass`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_bandpass.md)(動画の時間帯域(揺らぎ)、video → video)、[`motion_magnify`](../ops/motionmag/magnify/motion_magnify.md)(微小な動きの拡大、video → table)、[`video_spacetime_cube`](../ops/videocube/cube/video_spacetime_cube.md)(時空間の立方体、video → voxel)、[`video_summary_keyframes`](../ops/videocube/summary/video_summary_keyframes.md)(要約コマ、video → indices)、[`blob_count`](../ops/2d/features/blob_count.md)(スパッタ・粒の数、region → feature)、[`area_center`](../ops/2d/features/area_center.md)(溶融池の面積と重心、region → match)、[`volseq_magnify_motion`](../ops/live4d/time/volseq_magnify_motion.md)(3D+t の拍動の拡大、volseq → volseq)、[`focus_sweep_height_video`](../ops/live4d/render/focus_sweep_height_video.md)(焦点掃引 → 高さの時系列、volseq → video)
- 鋳造・塑性加工・焼結(内部欠陥の CT): [`filtered_backprojection`](../ops/tomography/reconstruct/filtered_backprojection.md)(CT 再構成、sinogram → image2d)、[`sart_reconstruct`](../ops/tomography/reconstruct/sart_reconstruct.md)(少数投影の再構成、sinogram → image2d)、[`beam_hardening_correct`](../ops/tomography/artifact/beam_hardening_correct.md)(カッピングの補正、sinogram → sinogram)、[`ring_artifact_remove`](../ops/tomography/artifact/ring_artifact_remove.md)(リングアーチファクト、sinogram → sinogram)、[`vol_label`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_label.md)(空隙のラベル、voxel → labels)、[`vol_region_props`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_region_props.md)(空隙の性質、labels → table)、[`filter_by_volume`](../ops/3d/regionprops/filter_by_volume.md)(大きさで選別、voxel → voxel)、[`vol_granulometry`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_granulometry.md)(空隙の大きさ分布、voxel → measurement)
